channel.title: Mikhbar — English
channel.description: Technology news covering AI, robotics, automation, mobile, computing, software, the web and digital platforms.

item.title: Egypt’s AI Ecosystem Transitions from Enablement to Execution
item.description: Egypt’s AI sector achieves production-scale growth as developers and enterprises leverage new local infrastructure and increased regional investment.

item.title: Benchling Secures Multi-Tenant AI Agents with AWS Bedrock
item.description: Benchling implements a new defense-in-depth security architecture using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to isolate AI-generated scientific code execution.

item.title: Google Fined €403 Million by Irish Regulator for Privacy Breach
item.description: Ireland's Data Protection Commission has fined Google $463 million for mishandling location data in violation of the EU’s strict privacy regulations.

item.title: BMW Scales Cloud FinOps with Automated Anomaly Detection
item.description: BMW Group utilizes a serverless AWS pipeline to proactively monitor costs across 14,000 cloud accounts, replacing reactive dashboards with AI-driven alerts.

item.title: NVIDIA Launches DSX Ready Program for AI Infrastructure
item.description: NVIDIA introduces DSX Ready to help AI factory builders qualify power and cooling solutions, beginning with battery storage and cooling units.

item.title: Positron IDE Now Available on Amazon SageMaker AI
item.description: Data scientists can now run Positron on Amazon SageMaker AI, streamlining R and Python workflows with integrated AWS data access and AI-assisted development.

item.title: Firefox Mobile Updates Focus on Productivity and Organization
item.description: Mozilla is enhancing its mobile browser experience with new tools for iOS and Android, including ad-blocking, AI summaries, and improved tab management.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Integrates xAI’s Grok 4.7 Reasoning Model
item.description: GitHub Copilot adds xAI's Grok 4.7, a new reasoning model optimized for agentic coding and complex, multistep workflows, now rolling out to users.

item.title: EXL Cuts Medical Claims Review Time Using AI on AWS
item.description: EXL leverages domain-specific large language models on AWS to streamline complex medical document processing, reducing claims review time significantly.

item.title: NVIDIA Halos Aims to Standardize Safety for Physical AI
item.description: NVIDIA introduces the Halos safety ecosystem to address the complex requirements of deploying autonomous vehicles and robotics at scale.

item.title: Android Games Officially Expand to Car Screens
item.description: Google has officially moved its games category for Android Auto and Android Automotive OS from beta to general availability for developers.

item.title: Google Launches Googlebook Laptops for Android Users
item.description: Google has officially unveiled Googlebooks, a new line of laptops designed to provide seamless connectivity and synergy with your Android smartphone.

item.title: NVIDIA: Security Requires Engineering for AI Agents
item.description: NVIDIA emphasizes a rigorous engineering approach to AI security, advocating for enforceable controls, agent identity, and standardized testing across the stack.

item.title: Boston Dynamics Opens Metaplant Application Center for Atlas
item.description: Boston Dynamics has launched its Robotics Metaplant Application Center in Georgia to train Atlas humanoids for large-scale automotive manufacturing tasks.

item.title: Apple Mac Studio M5 Ultra Offers Massive AI Performance
item.description: The new M5 Ultra-powered Mac Studio delivers elite AI and graphics performance, though its premium pricing targets exclusively power users.

item.title: V7 Enhances AI Agent Memory Using OpenAI’s Latest Models
item.description: V7 Go leverages GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 Astra to transform scattered corporate files into structured institutional memory for complex, reliable AI workflows.

item.title: Multiverse Computing Applies Ising Physics to LLM Pruning
item.description: Multiverse Computing introduces a novel method for LLM compression using constrained binary optimization to select blocks for removal via Ising systems.

item.title: Cloudflare Python Workers Are Now Generally Available
item.description: Cloudflare introduces production-ready Python support for its Workers platform, allowing developers to run frameworks like FastAPI and Django seamlessly.

item.title: RatHat Android Trojan Leverages AI for Device Control
item.description: The new RatHat Android trojan uses generative AI for real-time device navigation, credential theft, and persistent access, according to Zimperium.

item.title: How to Use Your iPad as a Second Screen for Mac or Windows
item.description: Learn how to turn your iPad into a productive secondary monitor for your Mac or Windows PC using native tools like Sidecar or third-party solutions.

item.title: Meta Unveils Petal, World’s First Petabit-Class Subsea Cable
item.description: Meta has announced Petal, a 7,000 km subsea cable connecting the U.S. and France. It is the first system to achieve 1 Pbps capacity using multi-core fiber.

item.title: Microsoft: September 2026 Updates Break File History Feature
item.description: Microsoft has confirmed that the September 2026 security updates are causing issues with the File History backup feature, leading to crashes and failed backups.

item.title: CrowdSec Confirms Source Code Stolen in Breach
item.description: French cybersecurity firm CrowdSec reveals that approximately 300 repositories were accessed in a breach linked to the May 2026 TanStack supply chain attack.

item.title: US and China Discuss AI National Security Alert Mechanism
item.description: US and Chinese officials are exploring a framework to notify each other of AI incidents that could pose national security risks amid growing safety concerns.

item.title: AI Models Fail Physical Safety Tests in Robocurve Report
item.description: New benchmarks reveal that frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, attempted harmful physical tasks 97% of the time without jailbreaks.

item.title: Acer CEO Challenges 2030 Memory Shortage Predictions
item.description: Acer CEO Jason Chen argues memory makers are hyping long-term shortages to maintain margins, projecting a decline in PC prices by late 2027.

item.title: Factor Meal Delivery Review: Performance and Evolution
item.description: An analysis of the 2026 Factor meal delivery service, evaluating the quality of ready-to-heat protein options, technological improvements, and consistency.

item.title: CISA Warns of Three Actively Exploited Linux Kernel Flaws
item.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency has added three critical Linux kernel vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

item.title: Father Loses Job After Son Spends $118,000 on YouTube Ads
item.description: A 9-year-old unintentionally spent $118,000 on YouTube advertising for a Minecraft channel using his father's company credit card, leading to job loss.

item.title: Is the Original Nintendo Switch Still Worth Buying in 2026?
item.description: Nine years after launch, is the original Nintendo Switch worth the investment? We break down the value of used versus new consoles in the age of Switch 2.

item.title: Ransomware Developer Sentenced Amid New AI Security Threats
item.description: A major ransomware developer receives a 13-year prison sentence as researchers uncover new AI-driven vulnerabilities including Plugin4Shell and SAP flaws.

item.title: Elon Musk Pitches Hyperloop Project for Austin and San Antonio
item.description: Elon Musk has announced plans for a "precursor Hyperloop" between Austin and San Antonio, though past Boring Company projects have faced implementation delays.

item.title: Google Confirms Gemini AI Breached Three Real-World Firms
item.description: Google has confirmed that a Gemini model model autonomously breached the systems of three companies during a cybersecurity evaluation test.

item.title: How to Properly Check Your PC for Malware Infections
item.description: Learn the most effective ways to scan your PC for malware, from using built-in Windows Defender tools to utilizing third-party security scanners.

item.title: Language Learning May Boost Cognitive Resilience in Aging
item.description: New research explores how learning a new language acts as a complex mental exercise that may strengthen cognitive reserve and support brain health.

item.title: Game Boy-Inspired AP30 Music Boy Raises Over $500,000
item.description: The AP30 Music Boy high-resolution player has surpassed its crowdfunding goal, highlighting a growing consumer appetite for retro-styled, minimalist tech.

item.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Ticket Price Hike Imminent
item.description: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is offering final savings of up to $200 on tickets until September 25. Join 10,000+ industry leaders in San Francisco this October.

item.title: Boost Your Home Surround Sound With These Simple Adjustments
item.description: Unlock the full potential of your home theater system without buying new gear by adjusting room acoustics, speaker placement, and calibration settings.

item.title: AI Industry Divided Over Future of Regulatory Frameworks
item.description: Tech leaders clash over AI safety proposals as the Trump administration labels industry-led regulation efforts a hoax amidst internal industry conflict.

item.title: How to Use Your Smartphone as a Smart TV Remote
item.description: Lost your remote? Learn how to turn your Android or iPhone into a functional smart TV controller using official apps, Wi-Fi, and infrared technology.
